fakta.asal: daftar aksi korporasi (rapat umum pemegang saham)
fakta.klaim:
Rapat umum pemegang saham 27 April 2026 mencatat keputusan: Agenda #1: The shareholders approved the company's Annual Report and Annual Financial Statements for the fiscal year. The decision was passed unanimously by the attending shareholders representing 84.053% of valid voting shares.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the proposed utilization of the company's net profit. This approval includes the distribution of cash dividends to shareholders.
Agenda #3: Shareholders approved changes to the composition of the company's Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors. Specific details regarding the individuals appointed or replaced were not stated.
Agenda #4: The meeting approved the appointment of a Public Accountant and/or a Public Accounting Firm for the company. Specific names of the appointed accountants were not stated.
Agenda #5: The shareholders approved the determination of salaries, honorariums, and other allowances for the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners for the year 2026. This agenda also included the approval of the division of duties and authorities for the Board of Directors.
